faq.title: Common questions
faq.a1: Yes - searching, comparing, and contacting vendors is completely free. We never add commission to any price.
faq.q2: Does milk.in sell or deliver milk?
faq.a2: No. We list every option near you - brands and local vendors - and you deal with them directly. We list, you choose, we never sell.
faq.q3: What does the Verified badge mean?
faq.a3: Our team has checked the business documents before the badge is shown. Verification can never be bought - and paid placements are always marked Sponsored.
faq.q4: How do I list my dairy business?
faq.a4: Tap List my business, verify with OTP, add your pincodes and products. Listing is free; advertising is optional.
